about: Estate player palette: token kind -> colour. Read by the Go server at startup (internal/server/palette.go) to colour party-table players; web/shared/tokens.js TOKEN_COLORS is its JS twin and web/tests/board.check.mjs fails if the two ever differ. Every colour is at least 19 CIEDE2000 from all eight property-group colours (the groups are 19.8 apart from each other). See the table in web/shared/tokens.css.
